title.en: Flow direction derived from one signed pressure value

summary: Check that arrows, phase labels and magnitudes all derive from a single signed pressure difference, including at equalization.
objective: Flow indicators follow the stored pressure sign everywhere, and equalization frames show zero flow.
applies_when: A scene shows directional flow driven by a pressure difference.
The cycle passes through instants where the difference is zero.
Phase names are authored labels rather than computed physiology.
intent_signals: arrows still move when the pressures are equal
check the airflow direction against the pressure
example_prompts: Check that airflow arrows follow the pressure sign through the whole breathing cycle.

principles: Flow direction is the sign of a pressure difference in this qualitative model, so one stored quantity should drive the arrow direction, the magnitude glyph and the phase label.
The equalization instant is a real state rather than a transition to skip: at zero difference the indicator must be zero instead of interpolating through a direction.
Phase names are authored labels over an illustrative sequence, so their timing carries no physiological calibration and must be presented that way.
implementation: Store the relative pressure of the compartment with respect to the atmosphere as one signed value per step and derive every visual element from it.
Step through the whole cycle including both zero crossings and record the signed pressure, arrow direction, phase label and whether the conducting path is drawn as connected.
Flip the stored sign once as a deliberate test and confirm that arrows follow the data rather than a direction hard-coded per phase name.
Check that the conducting path stays connected as the enclosing envelope moves, since a detached path implies an obstruction that is not part of the model.
observable_checks: Arrows point inward exactly when the stored relative pressure is negative and outward exactly when it is positive, with no exceptions across the cycle.
At every zero crossing the flow indicator is zero and the label says so; a moving arrow at zero difference is the failure signal.
Flipping the stored sign flips every derived arrow and label, demonstrating that presentation reads the model rather than the phase name.

known_limits: Qualitative quiet-breathing illustration; no pressure-volume calibration, gas exchange or patient-specific geometry is implied.
Authored verification guidance; no scene was run or rendered for this record.
creative_affordances: Adapt the scenario, scale and presentation to your subject; this record fixes what must be checked, not how the scene must look.

claims.statement: Air flows into the lungs when atmospheric pressure is greater than intra-alveolar pressure and out when pressure within the lungs becomes greater than atmospheric, and intrapulmonary pressure equalizes with atmospheric pressure during the cycle.
claims.scope: Qualitative quiet-breathing mechanism from the cited section; the authored phase timing is not sourced patient data.
